shortDescription: Manages a system startup information on HUAWEI CloudEngine switches.

options.name: cfg_file
options.description: Name of the configuration file that is applied for the next startup. The value is a string of 5 to 255 characters.

options.name: patch_file
options.description: Name of the patch file that is applied for the next startup.

options.name: slot
options.description: Position of the device.The value is a string of 1 to 32 characters. The possible value of slot is all, slave-board, or the specific slotID.

options.name: software_file
options.description: File name of the system software that is applied for the next startup. The value is a string of 5 to 255 characters.
